name: The Angel of the Lord
title: God's Heavenly Messenger
summary: The Angel of the Lord (mal'akh YHWH) is a mysterious heavenly figure who appears repeatedly in the Old Testament as God's special messenger and representative. In many texts, the Angel of the Lord seems to be identified with God himself, since he speaks with divine authority and those who meet him experience having seen God. Many theologians view the Angel of the Lord as a theophany – a manifestation of God, and some Christian interpretations link this figure to the pre-incarnate Christ.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord Meets Hagar in the Wilderness
keyEvents.description: When Hagar fled from Sarah, the Angel of the Lord found her by a spring in the wilderness and promised that her descendants would become numerous. He told her to return, and Hagar named the Lord who spoke to her 'You are a God who sees'.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord Stops Abraham's Sacrifice of Isaac
keyEvents.description: When Abraham was about to sacrifice his son Isaac on Mount Moriah, the Angel of the Lord called out from heaven and stopped him. The angel confirmed God's blessing upon Abraham because of his obedience.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord in the Burning Bush
keyEvents.description: The Angel of the Lord appeared to Moses in a flame within a bush that burned but was not consumed. From the bush, God spoke and revealed himself as 'I am who I am' and called Moses to deliver Israel from Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord Stands in Balaam's Way
keyEvents.description: When Balaam set out to curse Israel, the Angel of the Lord stood in his way with a drawn sword. The donkey saw the angel and turned aside three times before the Lord opened Balaam's eyes so he could see the angel.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord Calls Gideon to Service
keyEvents.description: The Angel of the Lord came and sat under the oak tree in Ophrah and called Gideon to deliver Israel from the Midianites. When Gideon brought an offering, the angel touched it with his staff, fire leaped from the rock and consumed the offering.

keyEvents.title: The Angel of the Lord Announces Samson's Birth
keyEvents.description: The Angel of the Lord appeared to Manoah's wife and announced that she would bear a son who would be a Nazirite and begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines. When Manoah offered a sacrifice, the angel ascended in the flame from the altar, and Manoah realized they had seen God.
